faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our secure notes tool.

items.q: Are my notes uploaded to servers?
items.a: No. All notes are processed locally inside your browser and never uploaded anywhere.
No. Your encrypted notes remain under your full control and we have no access to them.

items.q: Can I use Secure Notes on mobile?
items.a: Yes. The tool is fully responsive and mobile-friendly across all major platforms.

items.q: What if I forget my password?
items.a: Unfortunately, there is no way to recover your note without the password. We prioritize security over convenience.

items.title: Use Strong Passphrases
items.desc: The security of your note depends entirely on the strength of your password. Use 12+ characters.

items.title: Clear Clipboard After Use
items.desc: After copying your decrypted note, clear your clipboard to prevent other apps from seeing it.

items.title: Avoid Public Devices
items.desc: Never decrypt sensitive notes on public computers or shared devices where keyloggers might exist.

items.title: Store Encrypted Blocks
items.desc: Save your encrypted text in multiple safe locations. Without it, you cannot retrieve your data.

technical.title: Security Architecture & Cryptography
technical.desc: For security professionals and curious users, here is exactly how we protect your data using the native Web Crypto API.

steps.title: Key Derivation (PBKDF2)
steps.desc: Your password isn't used directly. We use PBKDF2 with HMAC-SHA256 and 100,000+ iterations to derive a secure 256-bit encryption key.

steps.title: Authenticated Encryption
steps.desc: We use AES-GCM (Galois/Counter Mode), which provides both confidentiality and authenticity, ensuring the data hasn't been tampered with.

steps.title: Initialization Vectors (IV)
steps.desc: Every encryption uses a unique, cryptographically strong random 96-bit IV, preventing pattern recognition in ciphertext.

steps.title: Zero-Server State
steps.desc: No keying material, salt, or IVs are ever stored outside your device. You are the sole custodian of your digital vault.

verification.title: How to Verify Our Claims
verification.subtitle: We believe in "Don't Trust, Verify". Here is how you can check our security yourself.

items.title: Network Audit
items.desc: Open Browser DevTools (F12) -> Network tab. Perform an encryption. You will see 0 requests sent to any server.

items.title: Local-Only Logic
items.desc: Turn off your Wi-Fi and use the tool. It works 100% offline, proving no server is needed for processing.

items.title: Code Transparency
items.desc: Inspect the page source. All cryptographic logic is handled via the native window.crypto API.
